title: Self-healing X14: a closed action catalog, a validator, repair budgets and circuit breakers in Go
summary: failure-decision.json already has closed enums (go/internal/policy/policy_failure.go:5-15, go/internal/core/failure_decision.go:26-52). The catalog extends them to retry-with-variation, reroute-family, quarantine-item, revert-last-landing, open-repair-item and halt-and-escalate. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §19.
fix: Implement the catalog with preconditions and tier limits, the validator that accepts or refuses a diagnosis, the repair budgets for each tier and window, the breaker for each incident class with half-open, and converge-or-escalate after two failed repairs (ADR-0126). Budgets are T0 policy data. Stage shadow: record decisions, the console acts.
acceptance: RED first: TestBudget_RefusesTheFourthT1RepairInAWindow and TestBreaker_OpensAfterTwoFailedRepairs fail before
TestValidator_RefusesAnActionOutsideTheCatalog and a test for each precondition
Each refusal emits HEALING_PROPOSAL_REFUSED with the failed precondition
